autograph_assets_state_consistency.name: autograph_assets_state_consistency
autograph_assets_state_consistency.value: ("autograph_assets"."role" = 'original' AND "autograph_assets"."expected_content_type" IS NOT NULL AND "autograph_assets"."expected_size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "autograph_assets"."upload_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "autograph_assets"."actual_content_type" IS NULL AND "autograph_assets"."width" IS NULL AND "autograph_assets"."height" IS NULL AND (("autograph_assets"."status" = 'reserved' AND "autograph_assets"."uploaded_at" IS NULL AND "autograph_assets"."verified_size_bytes" IS NULL) OR ("autograph_assets"."status" = 'uploaded' AND "autograph_assets"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "autograph_assets"."verified_size_bytes" IS NOT NULL))) OR ("autograph_assets"."role" <> 'original' AND "autograph_assets"."status" = 'uploaded' AND "autograph_assets"."expected_content_type" IS NULL AND "autograph_assets"."expected_size_bytes" IS NULL AND "autograph_assets"."upload_expires_at" IS NULL AND "autograph_assets"."actual_content_type" = 'image/png' AND "autograph_assets"."verified_size_bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760 AND "autograph_assets"."width" BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND "autograph_assets"."height" BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND "autograph_assets"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL)

autograph_moderation_decisions_reason_ch.name: autograph_moderation_decisions_reason_check
autograph_moderation_decisions_reason_ch.value: ("autograph_moderation_decisions"."decision" = 'approved' AND "autograph_moderation_decisions"."reason_code" IS NULL) OR ("autograph_moderation_decisions"."decision" = 'rejected' AND "autograph_moderation_decisions"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL)

autograph_processing_jobs_state_consiste.name: autograph_processing_jobs_state_consistency
autograph_processing_jobs_state_consiste.value: ("autograph_processing_jobs"."status" = 'queued' AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("autograph_processing_jobs"."status" = 'processing' AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("autograph_processing_jobs"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "autograph_processing_jobs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

creator_earnings_amount.name: creator_earnings_amount
creator_earnings_amount.value: "creator_earnings"."currency" = 'RUB' AND "creator_earnings"."share_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "creator_earnings"."gross_amount_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000000 AND "creator_earnings"."amount_minor" = ("creator_earnings"."gross_amount_minor" * "creator_earnings"."share_bps") / 10000

legal_evidence_semantics.name: legal_evidence_semantics
legal_evidence_semantics.value: ("legal_evidence_events"."document_type" IN ('terms_of_use','community_guidelines','public_offer','refund_policy') AND "legal_evidence_events"."action" = 'accepted' AND "legal_evidence_events"."scope" IS NULL AND "legal_evidence_events"."purpose" = 'contract') OR ("legal_evidence_events"."document_type" IN ('personal_data_consent','personal_data_dissemination_consent') AND "legal_evidence_events"."action" IN ('granted','withdrawn') AND "legal_evidence_events"."scope" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("legal_evidence_events"."scope") = 'object' AND ("legal_evidence_events"."scope"->>'purpose' = "legal_evidence_events"."purpose") IS TRUE AND "legal_evidence_events"."purpose" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$' AND "legal_evidence_events"."purpose" <> 'contract')

notification_delivery_state.name: notification_delivery_state
notification_delivery_state.value: "notification_deliveries"."channel" IN ('web','telegram') AND "notification_deliveries"."state" IN ('queued','sending','sent','retry','uncertain','failed','suppressed') AND "notification_deliveries"."attempts" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

notification_telegram_consent.name: notification_telegram_consent
notification_telegram_consent.value: NOT "notification_preferences"."telegram" OR ("notification_preferences"."chat_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_preferences"."consent_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_orders_legal_snapshot.name: payment_orders_legal_snapshot
payment_orders_legal_snapshot.value: ("payment_orders"."offer_version" IS NULL AND "payment_orders"."offer_hash" IS NULL AND "payment_orders"."content_rules_version" IS NULL AND "payment_orders"."content_rules_hash" IS NULL AND "payment_orders"."refund_policy_version" IS NULL AND "payment_orders"."refund_policy_hash" IS NULL) OR ("payment_orders"."offer_version" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_orders"."offer_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_orders"."content_rules_version" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_orders"."content_rules_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_orders"."refund_policy_version" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_orders"."refund_policy_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_orders"."offer_version" ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$' AND "payment_orders"."content_rules_version" ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$' AND "payment_orders"."refund_policy_version" ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$' AND "payment_orders"."offer_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "payment_orders"."content_rules_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "payment_orders"."refund_policy_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

payment_orders_amount.name: payment_orders_amount
payment_orders_amount.value: "payment_orders"."amount_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000000 AND "payment_orders"."currency" = 'RUB' AND "payment_orders"."creator_share_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

payment_orders_fulfillment.name: payment_orders_fulfillment
payment_orders_fulfillment.value: ("payment_orders"."status" = 'fulfilled' AND "payment_orders"."placement_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_orders"."fulfilled_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payment_orders"."status" <> 'fulfilled' AND "payment_orders"."placement_id" IS NULL AND "payment_orders"."fulfilled_at" IS NULL)

payments_verified.name: payments_verified
payments_verified.value: "payments"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded','fulfilled','paid_but_not_fulfilled') OR ("payments"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."provider_payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

placements_end_consistency.name: placements_end_consistency
placements_end_consistency.value: ("placements"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "placements"."end_reason" IS NULL) OR ("placements"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "placements"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("placements"."end_reason")) > 0 AND "placements"."ended_at" >= "placements"."started_at")

pricing_config_amounts_valid.name: pricing_config_amounts_valid
pricing_config_amounts_valid.value: "pricing_config_versions"."minimum_amount_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000000 AND "pricing_config_versions"."base_amount_minor" BETWEEN "pricing_config_versions"."minimum_amount_minor" AND "pricing_config_versions"."maximum_amount_minor" AND "pricing_config_versions"."maximum_amount_minor" <= 100000000000 AND "pricing_config_versions"."step_amount_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000000000 AND "pricing_config_versions"."decay_amount_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000000000 AND "pricing_config_versions"."decay_floor_amount_minor" BETWEEN "pricing_config_versions"."minimum_amount_minor" AND "pricing_config_versions"."maximum_amount_minor"

takeover_quotes_snapshot_valid.name: takeover_quotes_snapshot_valid
takeover_quotes_snapshot_valid.value: "takeover_quotes"."wall_takeover_count" >= 0 AND "takeover_quotes"."step_index" >= 0 AND "takeover_quotes"."decay_intervals_applied" >= 0 AND (("takeover_quotes"."wall_takeover_count" = 0 AND "takeover_quotes"."last_takeover_at" IS NULL) OR ("takeover_quotes"."wall_takeover_count" > 0 AND "takeover_quotes"."last_takeover_at" IS NOT NULL))

takeover_reservations_state_valid.name: takeover_reservations_state_valid
takeover_reservations_state_valid.value: ("takeover_reservations"."status"::text = 'consumed' AND "takeover_reservations"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."expired_at" IS NULL) OR ("takeover_reservations"."status" = 'active' AND "takeover_reservations"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."expired_at" IS NULL) OR ("takeover_reservations"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "takeover_reservations"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."expired_at" IS NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."cancelled_at" >= "takeover_reservations"."created_at") OR ("takeover_reservations"."status" = 'expired' AND "takeover_reservations"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "takeover_reservations"."expired_at" >= "takeover_reservations"."created_at")

walls_end_after_start.name: walls_end_after_start
walls_end_after_start.value: "walls"."start_at" IS NULL OR "walls"."end_at" IS NULL OR "walls"."end_at" > "walls"."start_at"
